hero.lead_before: For 15 years AAEGB has been working in the Cacine Sector, promoting autonomy through Escola Betel, housing, clean water and technology for the
hero.lead_after: and neighboring communities to build their own future.

projects_section.p: Escola Betel is the heart of the mission, but the impact grows when each project removes a concrete barrier to studying, living healthily and dreaming of the future.

map.h2: Real presence in the territory of Guinea-Bissau.
map.p: Partners fund actions with local grounding: a mission embedded in West Africa, connected to the Tombali Region and committed to the Cacine Sector.

story.h2: Voices of those living the transformation
story.video_desc: Learn in detail the story of impact and transformation lived by those served by AAEGB in southern Guinea-Bissau.
story.blockquote: "I walked three hours to study. Today I live in the Student House and dream of becoming a teacher."
story.blockquote_2: "The arrival of clean water and the school changed the life of our village. Our children now have a future."
story.p: Each partnership shortens distances, protects dreams and multiplies leaders who remain serving their own communities.
